zusammenfassung: Week 17 marks a concentration of autonomous workflows: OpenAI, Google and DeepSeek simultaneously ship products that move from single prompts to agents that run continuously. ChatGPT Images 2.0 sets a new standard in design with thinking-based image generation. DeepSeek V4 again delivers open-source quality at frontier level for a fraction of the price. Chronicle establishes itself as a serious PowerPoint competitor for teams. The message of the week: AI agents are becoming team infrastructure, no longer just individual tools.
highlights: ChatGPT Images 2.0 (9/10) and DeepSeek V4 (9/10): thinking-based image generation meets the open-source frontier, two releases that recalibrate the market
Trend: AI agents become team infrastructure. OpenAI Workspace Agents, Gemini Deep Research Max and DeepSeek V4 show that autonomous systems now run continuously, not just on demand
Shift: from all-in-one to specialised solutions
